@title BlockFinaXHedgeFacet
 @notice On-chain P2P Hedge — FX protection marketplace
 Lifecycle:
   1. Creator calls createEvent() — pays creation fee, deposits initial liquidity
   2. Creator calls setPoolOpen(true) — opens pool for hedgers
   3. LPs call deposit() — add USDC, receive proportional shares
   4. Hedgers call buyProtection() — pay premium (→ LPs) + platform fee
   5. Oracle admin calls settleEvent() — posts FX rate, resolves all positions
   6. Hedgers call claimPayout() — collect winnings (minus 1% fee)
   7. LPs call claimPremiums() — collect earned premiums (minus 1% fee)
   8. LPs call withdrawCapital() — retrieve deposited USDC after settlement
 Fee structure:
   - Event creation: 25 USDC flat fee
   - Hedger fee: 0.5% of notional (on top of premium)
   - Hedger payout fee: 1% of gross payout (deducted at claim)
   - LP profit fee: 1% of premium claim (deducted at claim)
   - Creator loyalty: 5% of every platform fee → event creator
 Security:
   - nonReentrant on all state-changing user functions
   - CEI (Check-Effects-Interactions) ordering throughout
   - Emergency pause via pause()/unpause()
   - Two-step ownership transfer (propose + accept)
   - Bounded loops: MAX_POSITIONS_PER_EVENT = 500, MAX_DEPOSITS_PER_EVENT = 200
   - Fee initialization guard — createEvent() reverts until initializeHedgeFees() called
   - Max expiry 365 days, max premiumRate 100% (PRECISION)
 All USDC is held by the Diamond contract. No external treasury wallet needed.
@dev Maximum hedger positions per event — caps settleEvent() loop gas cost
@dev Maximum LP deposits per event — caps _distributePremiumToLps() loop gas cost

@title BlockFinaXOracleFacet
 @notice Multi-signer oracle facet for the BlockFinaX Diamond.
 ISOLATION GUARANTEE
 -------------------
 This facet is an additive upgrade. It does not modify any existing facet
 or library. It uses LibOracleStorage (its own Diamond storage slot) and
 reads/writes LibAppStorage only to settle events — using the same fields
 that HedgeFacet.settleEvent() writes, so settlement results are fully
 compatible with claimPayout / claimPremiums / withdrawCapital.
 SETTLEMENT FLOW
 ---------------
 1. Admin registers N oracle wallets via addOracle() (max MAX_ORACLES = 10).
 2. Admin sets requiredSigners (default 2) and toleranceBps (default 100 = 1%).
 3. Each oracle node independently calls submitRate(eventId, price).
 4. When requiredSigners valid submissions exist and all prices agree within
    toleranceBps, the facet settles the event automatically at the average price.
 5. If submissions disagree (spread > toleranceBps) they are cleared and
    nodes must resubmit after their next poll cycle.
 6. Stale submissions (older than 15 min) are ignored at consensus check.
 7. Admin can call clearStaleSubmissions() to manually unstick a stuck event.
 COMPATIBILITY
 -------------
 The existing HedgeFacet.settleEvent() continues to work unchanged via
 the hedgeOracleAdmin single-key path. Both paths can coexist — once you
 add oracle wallets to this facet you can migrate settlement exclusively
 to this path by removing DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY from the single-key oracle.
@dev Maximum number of registered oracle wallets (bounds _checkConsensus loop)

Settlement executes automatically when consensus is reached."}},"notice":"Multi-signer oracle facet for the BlockFinaX Diamond. ISOLATION GUARANTEE ------------------- This facet is an additive upgrade. It does not modify any existing facet or library. It uses LibOracleStorage (its own Diamond storage slot) and reads/writes LibAppStorage only to settle events \u2014 using the same fields that HedgeFacet.settleEvent() writes, so settlement results are fully compatible with claimPayout / claimPremiums / withdrawCapital. SETTLEMENT FLOW --------------- 1. Admin registers N oracle wallets via addOracle() (max MAX_ORACLES = 10). 2. Admin sets requiredSigners (default 2) and toleranceBps (default 100 = 1%). 3. Each oracle node independently calls submitRate(eventId, price). 4. When requiredSigners valid submissions exist and all prices agree within    toleranceBps, the facet settles the event automatically at the average price. 5. If submissions disagree (spread > toleranceBps) they are cleared and    nodes must resubmit after their next poll cycle. 6. Stale submissions (older than 15 min) are ignored at consensus check. 7. Admin can call clearStaleSubmissions() to manually unstick a stuck event. COMPATIBILITY ------------- The existing HedgeFacet.settleEvent() continues to work unchanged via the hedgeOracleAdmin single-key path. Both paths can coexist \u2014 once you add oracle wallets to this facet you can migrate settlement exclusively to this path by removing DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY from the single-key oracle.","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/facets/BlockFinaXOracleFacet.sol":"BlockFinaXOracleFacet"},"evmVersion":"paris","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[],"viaIR":true},"sources":{"src/facets/BlockFinaXOracleFacet.sol":{"keccak256":"0x064b00d55ae7c3faca4e7d14c6b8dc1dc4637cb8f8e86e0896cf3d9c791fe8b4","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://f42dfd97ddead87b0b8bfbd2f5df0286e513ebb49263bf449165c7ca14262007","dweb:/ipfs/QmbEGGUPfJsFcjHVJ7RerWveFaFnyiDKPPewURtiJ3eK1q"]},"src/interfaces/IDiamondCut.sol":{"keccak256":"0x30a7bd9f723aacbbf3b1b46cde46e1f8da2151f66f38fb69b0b63b3c07c6f922","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://631a340512f0eac674e508908f62486f7a5e733f467e034975cd3580182daf7f","dweb:/ipfs/QmQ6VLQJ3jmMaHG9yfdy89dAbKdV4JkyiyqBN7r7wZpMUG"]},"src/libraries/LibAppStorage.sol":{"keccak256":"0xfba76d9e789a58f0866ceb86c07768e0b9a5baafa5fc8ee7cc3b2e37a27dd939","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://77e04216c45c9d3c57098398293dc2872d4a15a5fb0a85ad71e00fe4763ed419","dweb:/ipfs/QmdBKNcjQpRombMwC9C59YEU6BRwX7ME5sj2pe2neUP3qQ"]},"src/libraries/LibDiamond.sol":{"keccak256":"0x44ccfaa8c5e07d5be85b89ab2da64c8738f919c0cc1023aa16756c3e85b65062","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://6372eff2700226692f033e07b28625b412f03e7e88b44476cbfa3dd69616b551","dweb:/ipfs/Qmc27BBbmzG1YagNxYhjcDRF9CH6toSheMcd62GZvmcZ8M"]},"src/libraries/LibOracleStorage.sol":{"keccak256":"0x142e35875ecd5b83fc9ddf5b7010dbc63e5eea5831dd1e7b0fcfbec50e172a8e","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://9ad974be16cdc018f1024af5d705661838d6d3ab712b1fc2fd284ba688988088","dweb:/ipfs/QmWiREFkAaM2qjcydgJfH8MzgSFqa924FZEXy2VDLawddP"]}},"version":1}
